data.title: Arthur Hayes Sees Ethereum at $10,000 by December. Ethereum Has Never Gained 270% in a Quarter From This Size.
data.description: Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX and chief investment officer at Maelstrom, believes Ethereum (CRYPTO:ETH) could reach $10,000 by the end of 2026. He shared this Ethereum $10,000 target in his newsletter dated September 3, when Ethereum’s price was around $2,379.
